jobs.occupation: W2 Professorship “Sustainable Freight Transport Systems and Transport Logistics" (Ingenieur/in - Verkehrswesen)
jobs.description: W2 Professorship “Sustainable Freight Transport Systems and Transport Logistics"Application deadline:30.12.2026Date of hire:as soon as possibleVacancy number:39565We are seeking an academically outstanding individual (m/f/d) who will make an independent inter- and transdisciplinary contribution to research in the field of sustainable freight transport systems and logistics. The content focus is at the intersection of value chains, freight transport, and sustainable production systems. The professorship shall connect and strengthen the sustainability-related systems analytical topics at the Kassel Institute for Sustainability and the transportation science topics in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering. Moreover, there is an aim to foster networking in the fields of supply chains and intralogistics with the relevant departments of Economics and Mechanical Engineering. This is intended to further the interdisciplinary interaction between technical and societal research approaches and to advance the research focus on sustainable transformation at the University of Kassel.The professorship should focus on at least one of the following topics:1. Systemic analysis of the interdependencies between freight transport systems, trade, and economic development: Origin of freight transport, economic and ecological evaluation of interregional division of labor, interactions between infrastructure (e.g., rail), regional production clusters and division of labor, as well as sustainable design of these relationships.2. Modeling of the freight transport system: Development and application of scenarios and models for the origin, development, and management of freight transport, infrastructure development and the associated policy instruments, as well as the advancement of corresponding methods.3. Development and application of comprehensive approaches for sustainability evaluation of the ecological, social, and economic effects of strategies and interventions in freight transport, as well as, based on these, the design of a sustainable freight transport system.Experience in the collection, analysis, and management of data in the context of the transformation towards a sustainable freight transport system is also desirable, including the consideration of AI methods: development of data collection procedures and methods of data analysis and data-driven forecasts based on statistical and AI methods, issues regarding the (public) availability and use of data.In teaching, the professorship should supplement and enhance existing degree programs in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, and to develop new or emerging study programs with a focus on sustainability. Teaching responsibilities are to be divided, with 50% in sustainability-related degree programs and 50% in offerings within the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering. Some courses must be taught in English. It is expected that the appointee, especially regarding official duties in teaching and academic self-administration, will acquire sufficient proficiency in the German language in due course, if not already possessed.The main location for the professorship will be at the Kassel Institute for Sustainability.Special notes: The department aims to increase the proportion of female professors and expressly encourages female scientists to apply.The requirements for appointment and performance are in accordance with §§ 67, 68 HessHG. Specifically, a completed, qualified doctorate as well as a habilitation or equivalent additional academic achievements, as evidenced by scientific publications, are required. You should also possess pedagogical aptitude and commitment to academic teaching, as well as a pronounced willingness for interdisciplinary collaboration.Please submit a curriculum vitae, certificates, diplomas, a list of scientific works, three selected publications, a research and teaching concept (maximum three pages each), as well as a list of previous courses taught, existing teaching evaluations, and any higher education didactic trainings with your application. Additionally, please submit a brief concept (maximum three pages) outlining your ideas for a professional and institutional connection to the Kassel Institute for Sustainability.For questions, please contact Prof. Dr. Angela Francke, Tel.: +49 561 804-7703, Email: angela.francke(at)uni-kassel.de. We kindly ask you to submit the complete application documents as a single PDF document via the University of Kassel's application portal.

jobs.description: At our Osnabrück location, we are seeking a full-timeManagement Assistant (m/f/d)Your responsibilities:- active contribution to the optimization of business processes and workflows- Communicating within the Mitsubishi Group (primarily with Japan)- Responsibility for organizing and conducting internal and external audits, including the creation, updating, implementation, and management of work instructions, guidelines, and corporate standards- Serving as the point of contact (m/f/d) for general IT-related questions and acting as the liaison with the external IT service provider- Supporting management with administrative and organizational matters as well as projects- Involvement in insurance mattersYour Profile:- Successfully completed commercial vocational training or a college degree, as well as initial professional experience in a comparable position- fluency in spoken and written German and English- a structured, results-oriented approach to work, excellent communication and writing skills, and a high degree of organizational ability- IT proficiency combined with a strong willingness to familiarize yourself with these topics- a passion for tackling topics across various fields, discretion, flexibility, and a commitment to excellence round out your profileWe offer you:- a permanent employment contract in an international environment with the goal of a long-term partnership- a training program tailored to your individual needs, as well as ongoing professional development opportunities- attractive earning potential and benefits such as Hansefit, bike leasing with an employer subsidy, free beverages, and company events- opportunities for personal and professional growth and to take on more challenging responsibilitiesWe look forward to receiving your Application in English!

jobs.occupation: Business Development Specialist - Biomonitoring (all genders) - East, North-West, Rhine-Main (Pharmazeut/in)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Your role:Microbiological contamination control is at the heart of pharmaceutical manufacturing quality — and in this role, you will be the driving force behind expanding a cutting-edge portfolio of microbiological testing and automation solutions across key German markets. You will take full ownership of a defined territory, developing and executing a strategic account plan that targets new customer acquisition, deepens existing relationships, and positions the portfolio as the partner of choice within the pharmaceutical and biotech sector.You will engage consultatively with technical and commercial stakeholders across complex, multi-stakeholder organizations, guiding them through high-value capital investment decisions with clarity and credibility. By combining deep microbiological expertise with a structured approach to pipeline management, you will identify untapped market opportunities, introduce advanced automation and robotics solutions, and deliver measurable revenue growth. Your ability to navigate long sales cycles and translate technical value into business outcomes will be central to your success in this role.Who you are:- You bring at least 5 years of field sales experience in pharmaceutical quality control, production, or a closely related life science sector, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding commercial targets in complex business-to-business environments.- You hold academic degree in microbiology, biology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience); knowledge of laboratory automation or robotics is a strong advantage.- You have in-depth knowledge of pharmaceutical quality control and production environments, including familiarity with Good Manufacturing Practice guidelines, Annex 1 and cleanroom or aseptic processing requirements.- You are experienced in managing high-value, long-cycle capital expenditure sales processes, including stakeholder mapping across complex organizational structures and engagement at management level.- You are fluent in German (C2) and English (C1); an established professional network within the German pharmaceutical or life sciences industry is highly advantageous.- You hold a valid driver’s license and are willing to spend the majority of your working time in the field across east & north-west Germany as well as in the rhine-main area; candidates based within these regions are preferred.- You demonstrate strong negotiation and communication skills, with the confidence to engage credibly across both technical and commercial functions.- You have a proven ability to manage territory, spending over 70% of time in the field, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and you are highly self-directed and results-oriented, with a disciplined approach to pipeline management and territory planning.- You are familiar with artificial intelligence concepts and tools, including their practical applications and limitations, and are able to apply this understanding to evaluate and use AI-supported solutions responsibly in a commercial context.LocationGermany (East / North-West / Rhine-Main ) | Field-based with regional travelWhat we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
